pr_title: dependency_collector: distinguish macOS deps by OS

issue_context.title: `uses_from_macos` bounds sometimes not being included in API
issue_context.body:
### `brew doctor` output

```shell
vagrant@ubuntu2004:~$ brew doctor
Your system is ready to brew.
```


### Verification

- [X] My "`brew doctor` output" above says `Your system is ready to brew.` and am still able to reproduce my issue.
- [X] I ran `brew update` twice and am still able to reproduce my issue.
- [X] This issue's title and/or description do not reference a single formula e.g. `brew install wget`. If they do, open an issue at https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/issues/new/choose instead.

### What were you trying to do (and why)?

Seeing some oddities in how some `uses_from_macos` dependencies are being presented in the API, and I'm unsure how to reproduce locally. Take a look at `glib`: 
```
$ HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_FROM_API=1 brew info glib --json | jq '.[0].uses_from_macos_bounds'
[
  {
    "since": "catalina"
  },
  {
    "since": "catalina"
  }
]
```
This correctly reflects the formula definition. However, https://formulae.brew.sh/api/formula/glib.json shows the constraint only applying to python, but not libffi. 

Other formulae that define `uses_from_macos` with `since:` seem to consistently be output correctly or not, depending on the dependency, e.g. the API is correct for `bowtie2` (uses python), `git-filter-repo` (uses git) and `gnustep-base` (uses icu4c); but not for `braid` (uses ruby), `git` (uses curl and zlib), `gnupg` (uses sqlite), `vapor` (uses swift), `micromamba` (uses libarchive), `rex` (uses perl) and `tkdiff` (uses tcl-tk). 

### What happened (include all command output)?

See above.

### What did you expect to happen?

The output of `brew info glib --json | jq '.[0].uses_from_macos_bounds'` should be consistent whether the API is being used or not.

### Step-by-step reproduction instructions (by running `brew` commands)

Compare the results of: 
```shell
$ HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_FROM_API=1 brew info glib --json | jq '.[0].uses_from_macos_bounds'
[
  {
    "since": "catalina"
  },
  {
    "since": "catalina"
  }
]
```
with:
```
$ HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_FROM_API= brew info glib --json | jq '.[0].uses_from_macos_bounds'
[
  {},
  {
    "since": "catalina"
  }
]
```
comments:
That's really odd that `brew info --json` works with `HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_FROM_API` given the API is generated by the exact same code. Will have a look.

> May be related to #15566 somehow

There was no bounds in the API at all before that, so yeah.
Looks like the `uses_from_macos` deps are being cached irrespective of their `since:` value.

review_comments: There's probably a better way to do this, but this seems to work.

I think a better way is to fix `def hash` and `def ==` in `UsesFromMacOSDependency`.

The change here looks to regress in the case of differing tags.
Sorry, enabled auto-merge before I saw your comment @Bo98.
